If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is flat, adjust forecast upward by 0.5–1.5% for late horizon (16–30 days) if true outcome exceeds 1.5% above history mean.  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 2–3% for early horizon if recent history shows volatility.  
If sentiment is 1.00 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon if true outcome is consistently above forecast.  
If sentiment is 0.67 and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for late horizon if true outcome is below forecast by >0.8% for 3 consecutive days.
